'''Manny Rodriguez''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[RamapoCon II Constructed (5 May, 7 pm)]] on 5 May 2000 with Biker Scouts (started Combat Readiness), according to Jonny Chu's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d694">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapocon-ii-part-1-5-5-2000d694/ ramapocon-ii-part-1-5-5-2000], DeckTech (Jonathan "jonnychu" Chu, 8 May 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-05-08-ramapocon-ii-part-1-5-5-2000d694/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
